issues.text: ORCH: this is gate pass 3 of 3 for the tests of REQ-057, and the verdict is FAIL because of F1 alone (Medium: 'Start over' on the result screen does not have a test; one test case in QP-1b or QP-9j, no code change). By decisions/0079 item 4 a third FAIL is a stop: the owner decides whether to take F1 as one more small rework of TEST-DESIGNER with a limited check (mutant R06 and the probe P-R06 of this self_check) or to accept it as a Low item. I judged it Medium by the same yardstick as V04, X05 and X06 of step 18 (a documented rule of the design and a visible effect for the visitor: the old answers come back after 'Start over'); the Low items below do not block by themselves.

Follow-up list (Low, none blocks): F2 (stale header block on the result screen, R09), F3 (scroll at the result, R07), F4 (card after a storage refusal, C02 and C08), F5 (two blocks at once, N15), F6 (removeItem refused alone, W07), F7 (the edges of the stored version, S08), F8 (place of the net block in the tree, K09), F9 (live line of the loading, L02), F10 (hand-off ctx to the result screen, R01-R04 and N30; best taken up by REQ-058), F11 (K2: attributes from tenant text, A01-A07, A09, A10). Probes P-R09, P-R07, P-C02/C08, P-N15, P-W07, P-S08, P-K09, P-L02 are described in self_check and can be used as the body of the cases.
